# Attachment Endpoint

A clause that establishes an attached document’s return link to its parent. Paths refer to the document containing this endpoint, including when that document is nested.

## Configuration

The endpoint uses these `parameters`, with no supplied defaults:

- `relationship`: only `cross-embedded` contributes an embedding at `/sources/parent` and an `attachDocument` operation. Other values contribute neither.
- `linkBy`: the channel configured for `attachDocument`.
- `parentOrigin`: the required exact identity of the parent’s `/contracts/initialized/document`, distinct from the identity of the supplied parent publication.
- `authority`: the party-role name required in both documents’ party sets.

The configuration hook adds no parameter checks. Policy transitions are rejected with `ATTACHMENT_POLICY_IMMUTABLE`.

## Linking requirements

`attachDocument` receives a request with `document`: an exact publication of an existing initialized parent, supplied as a Blue ID reference. The request is passed through `call/request` to `linkParent`.

The caller must supply `call/requireExactDocumentVersion` equal to `true`. When the endpoint document has `/activation`, the inherited caller check also requires active status, valid participant access, and a `call/channel` naming a current party role or a representative channel named `role__repId`. Missing local `active` is read as `false` by this check. If `/activation` is absent, this caller check is skipped; that absence does not establish active status or satisfy the later party checks.

Participant-access validation covers party and representative channels and configured reader groups. For channels subject to timeline-access checks, a recognized access document selected through `accessPaths` must match the channel’s timeline and provider and allow at least one key from every reader group. Unsupported channel types are rejected.

Linking additionally requires:

- `relationship` equal to `cross-embedded`.
- The supplied parent’s initialized identity equal to `parentOrigin`, and its `/activation/active` equal to `true`.
- The parent’s and endpoint document’s `/activation/parties` to contain the same nonempty set of roles, including `authority`.
- For every role, matching exact `lead/channel` identities and matching nonempty, duplicate-free `readerKeys` sets. Key order does not matter. Missing `readerKeys` is read as `[]` and cannot satisfy this check. Representative lists are not compared by this roster check.

## Outcomes and recorded state

After these checks, a successful new link returns `acceptedNew`, stores the supplied publication’s Blue ID reference at `/sources/parent`, and writes the configured initialized-parent identity at `/attachmentLink/parentOrigin`.

If `/sources/parent` already exists, its initialized identity must still match `parentOrigin`; otherwise replacement is rejected. A matching existing link returns `duplicate` without updating the stored publication, even if a different publication of the same parent was supplied. All caller and supplied-parent checks run before this duplicate outcome.

Submitting a request does not establish a link. Successful acceptance records this document’s return link; it does not by itself confirm a separate parent-side attachment or completion of the attached work.
